targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | session_id=~"$session_id" | project=~"$project" | host_name=~"$host_name" | sandbox_profile${negate_sandbox_profile}"$sandbox_profile" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range]))

2 * sum(sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | session_id=~"$session_id" | project=~"$project" | host_name=~"$host_name" | sandbox_profile${negate_sandbox_profile}"$sandbox_profile" | unwrap cache_creation_tokens [$__range])) + 0.1 * sum(sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | session_id=~"$session_id" | project=~"$project" | host_name=~"$host_name" | sandbox_profile${negate_sandbox_profile}"$sandbox_profile" | unwrap cache_read_tokens [$__range])) + 1 * sum(sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | session_id=~"$session_id" | project=~"$project" | host_name=~"$host_name" | sandbox_profile${negate_sandbox_profile}"$sandbox_profile" | unwrap input_tokens [$__range])) + 5 * sum(sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | session_id=~"$session_id" | project=~"$project" | host_name=~"$host_name" | sandbox_profile${negate_sandbox_profile}"$sandbox_profile" | unwrap output_tokens [$__range]))

sum by (project_clean) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | session_id=~"$session_id" | project=~"$project" | host_name=~"$host_name" | sandbox_profile${negate_sandbox_profile}"$sandbox_profile" | sandbox_source=~".+" | label_format project_clean=`{{ if .sandbox_source }}~/sandboxes/{{ .sandbox_source }}{{ else }}~/sandboxes/{{ regexReplaceAll "^sandbox-" .host_name "" }}{{ end }}` | unwrap cost_usd [$__range])) or sum by (project_clean) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | session_id=~"$session_id" | project=~"$project" | host_name=~"$host_name" | sandbox_profile${negate_sandbox_profile}"$sandbox_profile" | sandbox_source="" | label_format project_clean=`{{ regexReplaceAll "/[^/]*worktree[^/]*/.*$" (regexReplaceAll "^(/home/[^/]+|/Users/[^/]+)" .project "~") "" }}` | unwrap cost_usd [$__range]))

sum by (env) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | session_id=~"$session_id" | project=~"$project" | host_name=~"$host_name" | sandbox_profile${negate_sandbox_profile}"$sandbox_profile" | label_format env=`{{ if .sandbox_source }}sb-{{ .sandbox_profile }}{{ else }}local{{ end }}` | unwrap cost_usd [$__range]))

1 * sum by (env) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | session_id=~"$session_id" | project=~"$project" | host_name=~"$host_name" | sandbox_profile${negate_sandbox_profile}"$sandbox_profile" | label_format env=`{{ if .sandbox_source }}sb-{{ .sandbox_profile }}{{ else }}local{{ end }}` | unwrap input_tokens [$__range])) + 5 * sum by (env) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | session_id=~"$session_id" | project=~"$project" | host_name=~"$host_name" | sandbox_profile${negate_sandbox_profile}"$sandbox_profile" | label_format env=`{{ if .sandbox_source }}sb-{{ .sandbox_profile }}{{ else }}local{{ end }}` | unwrap output_tokens [$__range])) + 0.1 * sum by (env) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | session_id=~"$session_id" | project=~"$project" | host_name=~"$host_name" | sandbox_profile${negate_sandbox_profile}"$sandbox_profile" | label_format env=`{{ if .sandbox_source }}sb-{{ .sandbox_profile }}{{ else }}local{{ end }}` | unwrap cache_read_tokens [$__range])) + 2 * sum by (env) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | session_id=~"$session_id" | project=~"$project" | host_name=~"$host_name" | sandbox_profile${negate_sandbox_profile}"$sandbox_profile" | label_format env=`{{ if .sandbox_source }}sb-{{ .sandbox_profile }}{{ else }}local{{ end }}` | unwrap cache_creation_tokens [$__range]))

sum by (model_short) (label_replace(sum by (model) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | session_id=~"$session_id" | project=~"$project" | host_name=~"$host_name" | sandbox_profile${negate_sandbox_profile}"$sandbox_profile" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range])), "model_short", "$1", "model", "([^@]*).*"))

sum by (tool_name) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_result" | session_id=~"$session_id" | project=~"$project" | host_name=~"$host_name" | sandbox_profile${negate_sandbox_profile}"$sandbox_profile" [$__range]))

label_replace(sum by (session_id) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | session_id=~"$session_id" | project=~"$project" | host_name=~"$host_name" | sandbox_profile${negate_sandbox_profile}"$sandbox_profile" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range])), "short_id", "$1..", "session_id", "(.{8}).*")

panels.description: Cost per skill/slash-command via prompt_id join with cross-prompt attribution. First-party skills get additional cost from continuation prompts via skill_name on api_requests (zero-valued entries preserve correct invocation count). Third-party plugin skills use original prompt_id attribution only.

targets.expr: sum by (prompt_id) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | session_id=~"$session_id" | project=~"$project" | host_name=~"$host_name" | sandbox_profile${negate_sandbox_profile}"$sandbox_profile" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range]))

sum by (prompt_id, invocation_name, source) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="user_prompt" | command_source="custom" | session_id=~"$session_id" | project=~"$project" | host_name=~"$host_name" | sandbox_profile${negate_sandbox_profile}"$sandbox_profile" | label_format invocation_name=`/{{.command_name}}`,source="slash" [$__range]) or count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_result" | tool_name="Skill" | session_id=~"$session_id" | project=~"$project" | host_name=~"$host_name" | sandbox_profile${negate_sandbox_profile}"$sandbox_profile" | label_format invocation_name=`{{ regexReplaceAll "^.*\"skill_name\":\"([^\"]+)\".*$" .tool_parameters "$1" }}`,source="skill_tool" [$__range])) or 0 * sum by (prompt_id, invocation_name, source) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | skill_name!="" | skill_name!="third-party" | session_id=~"$session_id" | project=~"$project" | host_name=~"$host_name" | sandbox_profile${negate_sandbox_profile}"$sandbox_profile" | drop cost_usd, cost_usd_micros, duration_ms, model, query_source, effort, speed, input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_tokens, cache_creation_tokens, request_id, event_sequence, event_timestamp, observed_timestamp, span_id, trace_id | label_format invocation_name=`/{{.skill_name}}`,source="slash" [$__range]))
